description: The rating's ratio is the average of the per-film rental-price-to-replacement-cost ratios.

b.request: For each film rating, show the rating, AVG(rental_rate / replacement_cost) over its films as the ratio, COUNT(*) of films, and that ratio minus the unweighted mean of all per-rating ratios, unrounded
b.sql: SELECT rating, AVG(rental_rate / replacement_cost) AS ratio, COUNT(*) AS films, AVG(rental_rate / replacement_cost) - AVG(AVG(rental_rate / replacement_cost)) OVER () AS ratio_minus_mean FROM film GROUP BY rating ORDER BY rating

a.request: For each film rating, first divide each film's `rental_rate` by its `replacement_cost`, then average those per-film ratios within the rating (averages ignore missing values). Show the rating, that average of per-film ratios, the number of films, and that value minus the plain average of the five rating-level values. Don't round.
a.sql: WITH per_rating AS (SELECT rating, AVG(CAST(rental_rate AS DOUBLE) / replacement_cost) AS avg_ratio, COUNT(*) AS films FROM film GROUP BY rating) SELECT rating, avg_ratio, films, avg_ratio - AVG(avg_ratio) OVER () AS diff_from_plain_avg FROM per_rating ORDER BY films DESC

c.request: For each film rating, what is the ratio of rental price to replacement cost? Show the rating, that ratio, the number of films, and how far the ratio is above or below the plain average of the ratios across all ratings (the rating's ratio minus that average). Averages ignore missing values. Don't round. The rating's ratio is the average of the per-film rental-price-to-replacement-cost ratios.
c.sql: SELECT rating, AVG(CAST(rental_rate AS DOUBLE) / replacement_cost) AS avg_rental_to_replacement_ratio, COUNT(*) AS films, AVG(CAST(rental_rate AS DOUBLE) / replacement_cost) - AVG(AVG(CAST(rental_rate AS DOUBLE) / replacement_cost)) OVER () AS diff_from_avg_ratio FROM film GROUP BY rating ORDER BY rating

d.request: For each film rating, what is the ratio of rental price to replacement cost, averaged across that rating's films? Show the rating, that average ratio, the number of films, and how far the average ratio is above or below the plain average of the per-rating averages (the rating's average ratio minus that overall average). Averages ignore missing values. Don't round.
d.sql: WITH rating_avg AS (SELECT rating, AVG(rental_rate / replacement_cost) AS avg_ratio, COUNT(*) AS films FROM film GROUP BY rating) SELECT rating, avg_ratio, films, avg_ratio - AVG(avg_ratio) OVER () AS diff_from_overall_avg FROM rating_avg ORDER BY rating
